articles.title: China's families are now supporting more old people than kids

events.summary: Recent figures reveal that Chinese families are now supporting more elderly individuals than children. The data highlights a milestone in Beijing's ongoing struggle with an ageing population.
events.why: China's demographic inversion has sweeping long-term ramifications for global economic growth, workforce supply, and social welfare sustainability.

articles.title: Canada signs trade deal with UAE in push for non-US markets

events.summary: Canada has signed a trade agreement with the United Arab Emirates in an effort to diversify beyond US markets. The deal is structured to lower tariffs, decrease red tape, and enhance market access for businesses.
events.why: The agreement diversifies Canada's export markets and deepens commercial integration with Gulf economies.

articles.title: Is AIPAC losing its grip on US politics?

events.summary: The pro-Israel lobbying organization AIPAC is altering its strategy. It is halting candidate endorsements and direct contributions to campaigns.
events.why: A strategic shift by one of Washington's most prominent lobby groups could alter campaign financing and foreign policy dynamics in Congress.

articles.title: Arab parties could hold key as Netanyahu and Eisenkot set to fall short of victory

events.summary: Neither the bloc led by Benjamin Netanyahu nor Benny Gantz/Eisenkot appears to have secured enough seats to form a government independently. Consequently, Arab political parties may hold the balance of power.
events.why: The reliance on Arab parties to break a parliamentary deadlock could shift coalition dynamics and domestic policy in Israel.

articles.title: A bust-up between mathematicians is fuelling fears that AI could undermine science

events.summary: A dispute among mathematicians has raised concerns regarding the role of AI in scientific accuracy. Despite prior scientific breakthroughs enabled by AI, questions are emerging about its reliability.
events.why: Errors or unreliability in AI-driven scientific research could compromise academic rigor and lead to flawed scientific models.

articles.title: Trump says US voter fraud is 'rampant' - evidence suggests it is extremely rare

events.summary: Donald Trump claimed that voter fraud is rampant in the US, prompting fact-checking that indicates such fraud is extremely rare. His remarks cast doubt on the integrity of the upcoming midterm elections.
events.why: Widespread unsubstantiated claims of election fraud undermine public trust in democratic institutions and electoral outcomes.

articles.title: What we know about Ukraine-Russia truce in Oleshky, brokered by Melania Trump

events.summary: Reports emerge concerning a Ukraine-Russia truce in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Residents have reportedly lacked electricity, gas, or water for three years and resorted to eating weeds to survive.
events.why: A localized truce could provide urgent humanitarian relief to a devastated population and signal rare diplomatic openings.
